name: battle-of-ankara-timur-bayezid
description: Timur's army crushed the Ottomans and captured Sultan Bayezid, plunging the young state into a decade of civil war.

name: bayezid-welcomes-sephardic-jews
description: Fleeing expulsion from Spain, Jewish refugees were invited into Ottoman lands, settling in Salonica and Istanbul.

name: selim-i-conquers-egypt-mamluks
description: Sultan Selim defeated the Mamluks and took Cairo, bringing the Arab heartlands and the holy cities under Ottoman rule.

name: battle-of-mohacs-ottoman-hungary
description: Suleiman's army destroyed the Hungarian royal host in under two hours, killing King Louis II and opening central Europe.

name: treaty-of-karlowitz-ottoman
description: Defeated by the Holy League, the Ottomans ceded Hungary and Transylvania to the Habsburgs in their first major territorial loss.

name: ibrahim-muteferrika-first-printed-book
description: Ibrahim Muteferrika, a Hungarian-born convert, ran the first Muslim-run Ottoman press and issued a dictionary in Turkish.

name: treaty-of-kucuk-kaynarca
description: A crushing defeat by Catherine the Great's Russia forced the Ottomans to cede Black Sea ports and free the Crimean Khanate.

name: janissaries-abolished-auspicious-incident
description: Sultan Mahmud II destroyed the rebellious elite infantry corps in an Istanbul massacre, clearing the way for a modern army.

name: tanzimat-reforms-gulhane-edict
description: The Gulhane decree promised all Ottoman subjects security of life and property, launching decades of modernising reform.

name: ottoman-constitution-midhat-pasha
description: Drafted by Midhat Pasha, a constitution created a parliament for the empire, but the sultan suspended it within two years.

name: ottomans-enter-first-world-war
description: Ottoman warships shelled Russian Black Sea ports, bringing the empire into the conflict alongside Germany.

name: armistice-of-mudros
description: Aboard a British warship, the Ottomans signed an armistice ending their fighting and opening Istanbul to Allied occupation.

name: ottoman-sultanate-abolished
description: Turkey's nationalist assembly ended the sultanate, and the last sultan, Mehmed VI, left Istanbul aboard a British warship.
